faqs.question: What is the official name and recognition status of NRI University?
faqs.answer: NRI University is officially named Dr. RVR NRI Institute of Technology, recognized as an Institution Deemed to be University under Section 3 of the UGC Act, 1956.

faqs.answer: The official websites for NRI University (Dr. RVR NRI Institute of Technology) are https://nriuniversity.in/ and https://rvrnriuniversity.edu.in/ (admissions portal: https://rvrnriuniversity.edu.in/admissions/, contact page: https://rvrnriuniversity.edu.in/contact-us/).

faqs.answer: NRI University lists five academic schools: School of Computer Studies, School of Engineering, School of Pharmaceutical Sciences, School of Science, Humanities & Management, and School of Paramedical & Allied Health Sciences.

faqs.question: Where is the NRI University campus located?
faqs.answer: Dr. RVR NRI Institute of Technology (NRI University) is located at Pothavarappadu (V), Via Nunna, Agiripalli (M), Vijayawada Rural, Eluru District, Andhra Pradesh - 521212.

faqs.question: Which undergraduate engineering (B.Tech) courses are offered at NRI University?
faqs.answer: Listed B.Tech branches are Computer Science & Engineering (CSE), CSE (AI & ML), CSE (Data Science), Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Information Technology (IT), Cyber Security, Electronics & Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical & Electronics Engineering (EEE), Mechanical Engineering, and Civil Engineering.

faqs.question: Which postgraduate engineering (M.Tech), MS by Research, and Ph.D. programs are offered?
faqs.answer: Listed M.Tech programs include CSE (plus specialized CSE tracks in Vedic Mathematics & Computational Intelligence, and NLP & Indian Languages), VLSI Design & Embedded Systems, Electrical Vehicle Technology, Thermal Engineering, and Structural Engineering, plus MS by Research in Environmental Sustainability using AI and Renewable Energy Systems. Ph.D. programs are listed in Pharmacy, Civil, CSE, ECE, EEE, Mechanical Engineering, Chemistry, English, Mathematics, and Physics.

faqs.question: What pharmacy, management, and commerce programs are listed at NRI University?
faqs.answer: Pharmacy courses include B.Pharmacy, Pharm.D, M.Pharmacy (Pharmaceutics, Pharmaceutical Analysis, Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance), and Ph.D. in Pharmacy. Management and arts/commerce programs include BBA, MBA (HR/Marketing/Finance, Design Thinking for Traditional Ecosystems, Culture & Heritage Tourism), B.Sc. in Aviation & Hospitality Management, M.Com (Entrepreneurship & Startup Ecosystem), B.Sc. in Vedic Sciences & Technology, and M.A. programs.

faqs.question: Which Allied Health Sciences and Life Sciences programs are offered at NRI University?
faqs.answer: Listed programs include BPT, MPT, B.MLS, M.MLS, BMRIT, M.MRIT, B.AOTT, M.AOTT, Bachelor/Master of Optometry, Bachelor/Master of Occupational Therapy, Paramedic (Emergency Medical Technologist / Advanced Care Paramedic), B.Sc./M.Sc. in Cardiovascular Technology, Agriculture, Food Science & Technology, Forensic Science, Digital Forensics & Cyber Security, Biotechnology/Medical Biotechnology, Microbiology/Clinical Microbiology, Genetics & Molecular Biology, Digital Health with AI & ML, Biomedical Sciences, Clinical Embryology, and Clinical Research.

faqs.question: How can I apply for UG and B.Tech admissions at SRM University-AP?
faqs.answer: Resident Indian applicants apply for B.Tech programs through SRMJEEE (UG) or SRMAPET via the official SRM University-AP Admissions portal. Applicants must score at least 60% aggregate in Class X and 60% in 10+2 Physics and Mathematics along with Chemistry, Computer Science, IT, or Informatics Practices (55% PCM for Civil, Mechanical, and EEE). Note that NRI, PIO, and OCI holders apply separately through the International Student portal.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for MBA, M.Tech, and Ph.D. programs at SRM University-AP?
faqs.answer: SRM University-AP admits PG and research applicants across the School of Engineering and Sciences (SEAS M.Tech & Ph.D.), Paari School of Business (MBA via SRMAP-MAT 2026), and Easwari School of Liberal Arts (ESLA) through its official admissions portal. CSE specializations in AI & Future Technologies and Product Engineering with AI additionally conduct a written test and interview after SRMJEEE rank shortlisting.

faqs.question: What B.Tech programs and specializations are offered at SRM University-AP?
faqs.answer: The School of Engineering and Sciences (SEAS) offers B.Tech degrees in Computer Science and Engineering (Core/General, AI & Machine Learning, Big Data Analytics, Cyber Security, Distributed & Cloud Computing, AI & Future Technologies, and Product Engineering with AI), Electronics & Communication Engineering (plus VLSI, Embedded Systems & IoT, Advanced Communication Systems), Electrical & Electronics Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Defence Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, and Quantum Computing & Engineering.

faqs.question: What postgraduate and doctoral courses are offered at SRM University-AP?
faqs.answer: SEAS offers 2-year M.Tech programs in AI & ML, Data Science, Cyber Security, VLSI, IoT & Embedded Systems, Thermal Engineering, Materials & Manufacturing Technology, and Environmental & Sustainable Engineering, plus Integrated M.Tech and Ph.D. programs. Paari School of Business (PSB) offers a 2-year MBA (Finance, Marketing, HRM, Business Analytics, Operations, Entrepreneurship & Family Business, Agribusiness Management) and B.Com/BBA.

faqs.question: How are campus placements and company visits at SRM University-AP?
faqs.answer: The Directorate of Corporate Relations & Career Services (CRCS) coordinates industry engagement, pre-placement training, and campus recruitment. According to the official Placement Tracker (2021–2026*), 677 companies visited for the 2026* graduating batch (up from 651 in 2025, 476 in 2024, 463 in 2023, and 640 in 2022), with IT/Software accounting for 69.6% of job roles (1,287 offers) followed by Consulting (11.9%).

faqs.question: What salary package tiers and highest offers have been recorded at SRM University-AP?
faqs.answer: In the official CRCS Placement Tracker for the 2026* batch, the highest package offered is Rs. 55 LPA, 734 students received offers of Rs. 5 LPA & above (66.43%), 206 received Rs. 10 LPA & above (18.64%), 98 received Rs. 15 LPA+, 17 received Rs. 40 LPA+, and 1 student received Rs. 50 LPA & above. Across the 2021–2026 department tracker, reported averages include Rs. 9.20 LPA for B.Tech CSE and Rs. 7.23 LPA for MBA (Management).

faqs.question: What placement package and key recruiters are reported for the PSB MBA program at SRM University-AP?
faqs.answer: According to the Paari School of Business (PSB) MBA programme page at SRM University-AP, the average placement package so far is Rs. 9 LPA for the current second MBA batch, with key recruiters including Deloitte, PwC, Human Resocia, and BNY Mellon, supported by specialized placement training.

faqs.question: What internship stipends are offered to students at SRM University-AP?
faqs.answer: Official CRCS Internship Stipend Records show an overall Highest Stipend of Rs. 2,25,000 (₹225K), Average Stipend of Rs. 26,200 (₹26.20K), and Minimum Stipend of Rs. 10,000. For the 2026 batch specifically, the highest stipend reached Rs. 2,25,000 and the average stipend rose to Rs. 31,320.

faqs.question: Are international and paid summer internships supported at SRM University-AP?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Office of International Relations coordinates global internship pathways and semester-abroad opportunities (such as with UC Berkeley and partner universities), while Paari School of Business MBA provides paid summer internships and corporate projects.

faqs.question: What boys and girls hostel accommodation capacity does SRM University-AP provide?
faqs.answer: SRM University-AP offers 4 dedicated Men's hostel blocks with a total capacity of approximately 4,000 students, 5 dedicated Women's hostel blocks with a total capacity of around 1,500 students, and a separate International Hostel with 150 to 300 capacity per block.

faqs.question: What dining and living facilities are inside the SRM University-AP hostels?
faqs.answer: SRM University-AP hostels include learning and recreation areas, a modern kitchen serving both vegetarian and non-vegetarian meals, food outlets, and tuck shops alongside regular mess services. Hostel room allocation is subject to availability after tuition fee payment and enrolment completion.

faqs.question: What resources and digital facilities are in the SRM University-AP Central Library?
faqs.answer: Located on the 12th floor of the C.V. Raman Block, the fully air-conditioned Central Library uses RFID automation and CCTV/fire security. Its collection includes 36,414 print volumes, 4,59,458 eBooks (via JSTOR & DELNET), 54,536 e-journals/e-magazines/e-newspapers, 881 CD/DVD ROMs, OPAC, and the mLibrary mobile app (Contact: librarian@srmap.edu.in, 0863-2343000 Extn 3062).

faqs.question: Does SRM University-AP provide campus bus transportation and what areas and fees apply?
faqs.answer: Yes. SRM University-AP states on its official SEAS Transportation Fee page that day-boarder students can avail of campus bus transport from Vijayawada, Guntur, Tadepalli, Tenali, and Raintree Park. Published 2026–27 full-year transport fees are Rs. 68,000 (1–30 km both ways), Rs. 72,000 (31–60 km), and Rs. 75,000 (61 km and above), subject to seat availability.

faqs.question: What sports and recreation facilities are available at SRM University-AP?
faqs.answer: SRM University-AP provides dedicated campus sports and athletics facilities under its Directorate of Sports and Campus Life, and also supports sports-quota admissions for eligible athletes.

faqs.question: How do I apply for B.Tech and UG admissions at KL Deemed to be University?
faqs.answer: KL Deemed to be University conducts admissions through KLEEE-2026 (KL Engineering Entrance Examination), JEE Mains, and KLECET for Lateral Entry. For 2026 counselling (scheduled 26–30 April 2026), candidates attend based on KLEEE rank (1–1,00,000), JEE Mains percentile (>=60%), or Intermediate % / Diploma marks, with a one-time admission fee of Rs. 16,000 payable at admission.

faqs.question: How are PG and international admissions handled at KL Deemed to be University?
faqs.answer: Applicants for M.Tech, MBA, MCA, M.Sc., and M.Pharmacy apply via the official KL University Admissions Portal, while international/NRI/Ph.D. applicants follow dedicated international admission guidelines listed in the UGC Mandatory Disclosure.

faqs.question: Which documents must be produced at the time of counselling at KL University?
faqs.answer: Per the KL University Counselling 2026 brochure, candidates must carry: (1) SSC / Class X Certificate, (2) Passport-size photographs, (3) Date of Birth Certificate, (4) Intermediate marks sheets, (5) Aadhar or Government Photo ID, (6) KLEEE-2026 Rank Card, (7) Reservation category certificate (if applicable), and (8) State/central level prize or award certificates (if applicable).

faqs.answer: Yes. Newly admitted candidates pay a one-time Admissions Fee of Rs. 16,000 (waived for KL Alumni pursuing further studies). faqs.question: What merit scholarships are available for B.Tech students in 2026-27 at KL University?
faqs.answer: KL University offers merit fee concessions for 2026–27 based on KLEEE-2026 ranks and JEE Mains percentiles: for instance, CSE candidates scoring >=95% JEE percentile or KLEEE Rank 1–100 receive a 50% tuition fee waiver (Rs. 73,750/semester), while 25%, 15%, 10%, and Rs. 5,000 slabs cover higher ranks across KLEEE 101–25,000 (and up to Rank 75,000 for CE/ME/EEE).

faqs.question: What special scholarships and CGPA continuation rules apply at KL University?
faqs.answer: Special annual scholarships include Rs. 10,000/yr for SC/ST/Differently Abled candidates, Siblings, Single Girl Child, Children of KL Alumni, and Children of Ex-Army Personnel; Rs. 5,000/yr for OBC candidates; and 100%/50%/25% tuition waivers for International/National/State sports medalists. Continuation from 2nd year requires zero backlogs, no indiscipline, and >=9.0 CGPA (CSE/AI&DS/ECE/BT/CS&IT), >=8.0 CGPA (ME/CE/EEE/IoT/PG), or >=7.5 CGPA (BBA/B.Com/LLB/BCA/B.Sc).

faqs.question: What are the highest and median salary packages at KL Deemed to be University?
faqs.answer: As reported in the official KL University 2026 Counselling Booklet (which does not specify the exact placement cycle year for these overall figures), the highest CTC recorded is Rs. 81 LPA and the Engineering median CTC is Rs. 7.25 LPA, with 5,000+ students placed in a single academic year and 6,500+ total job offers.

faqs.question: How many companies recruit at KL University campus placements?
faqs.answer: Over 500 global recruiting companies partner with KL University (including 370+ companies recruiting specifically from engineering programs). Every eligible student receives structured placement support through a 50+ member training team.

faqs.question: What placement training divisions exist at KL Deemed to be University?

faqs.answer: Per the PVPSIT Mandatory Disclosure, the campus provides specialized department laboratories equipped with licensed MATLAB, ANSYS, Creo, MiPower, PSCAD, and Nanotechnology instruments, campus internet, an auditorium, dispensary, cafeteria, and separate men's and women's gyms.

faqs.college_name: Prasad V Potluri Siddhartha Institute of Technology
faqs.question: What indoor and outdoor sports facilities exist at PVP Siddhartha Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: PVPSIT's Department of Physical Education (Director: Mr. M. Sambasiva Rao) offers 4 volleyball courts, 2 basketball courts, football & athletic field, cricket nets, ball badminton, throw ball, tennikoit, 3 table tennis tables, 5 chess boards, carrom, and separate men's and women's gyms. Arjuna Awardee badminton player Mr. B. Chetan Anand is a proud alumnus.

faqs.college_name: Prasad V Potluri Siddhartha Institute of Technology

faqs.question: How is anti-ragging enforced and whom can students contact at PVPSIT?
faqs.answer: PVPSIT maintains a 100% ragging-free campus through its Anti-Ragging Committee and mobile Anti-Ragging Squad conducting surprise checks across hostels, canteens, and bus stops. Complaints can be reported to Dr. Ch. Padmanabha Raju (9246400881) or the Administrative Office (0866-2581699).
